Ex: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.

entail

(verb). đòi hỏi, gây ra

Ex: They learn exactly what is entailed in caring for a newborn baby.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

Ex: Several factors had combined to ruin our plans.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

attribute

(noun). thuộc tính

Ex: The most basic attribute of all animals is consciousness.

arise

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: We keep them informed of any changes as they arise.

novel

(adjective). mới lạ

Ex: It was an American who came up with the novel idea of drive-in restaurants.

entirely

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: The experience was entirely new to me.

respond

(verb). phản ứng

Ex: How did they respond to the news?

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

avoid

(verb). tránh

Ex: We must find a way to avoid similar problems in future.

contrast

(noun). Sự tương phản

Ex: The flowers provide a contrast with the dark background.

recession

(noun). Sự lùi lại, sự thụt lại

Ex: Demand for new cars has fallen due to the recession.

mindset

(noun). tư duy

Ex: It's extraordinary how hard it is to change the mindset of the public and the press.

renewal

(noun). sự đổi mới, sự tái sinh

Ex: They felt the need to bring about a renewal of society.

impact

(verb). tác động

Ex: These restrictions will impact on all farmers in Ireland.

gain

(verb). đạt được, giành được

Ex: The country gained its independence ten years ago.

perspective

(noun). Góc nhìn

Ex: A historical perspective may help us understand the issue.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

pursue

(verb). Theo đuổi

Ex: She wishes to pursue a medical career.

highlight

(verb). nhấn mạnh

Ex: This study highlights the fact that couples are keen to assist others.

clash

(verb). xung đột, mâu thuẫn

Ex: His left-wing views clashed with his father's politics.

outcome

(noun). Kết quả

Ex: We are confident of a positive outcome.

focus

(noun). Trọng tâm, sự tập trung

Ex: Education is the current focus of public debate.

lack

(noun). sự thiếu

Ex: He was suffering from a complete lack of confidence.

analysis

(noun). phân tích

Ex: Further analysis revealed significant regional variations in the results.

disparity

(noun). khác biệt

Ex: The wide disparity between rich and poor was highlighted.

transcend

(verb). vượt quá, tốt hơn

Ex: His works by far transcend anything that has gone before.

integrate

(verb). Tích hợp, hợp thành thể thống nhất

Ex: The department has successfully integrated new ideas into the traditional course structure.
